extends SceneTree

func _init():
	var world = load("res://ecs/world.gd").new()
	assert(world is RefCounted)

	var e1 = world.create_entity()
	var e2 = world.create_entity()
	print("e1: ", e1, " e2: ", e2)
	assert(world.get_index(e1) != world.get_index(e2))
	assert(world.is_alive(e1) and world.is_alive(e2))

	assert(world.get_component_types(e1).is_empty())
	assert(world.get_component_types(e2).is_empty())

	world.add_component(e1, "pos", {"x": 10})
	world.add_component(e1, "vel", {"dx": 1})
	world.add_component(e2, "pos", {"x": 20})
	assert(world.has_component(e1, "pos") and world.has_component(e1, "vel"))
	assert(world.has_component(e2, "pos") and not world.has_component(e2, "vel"))
	assert(world.get_component(e1, "pos").x == 10)

	var exact = world.get_entities_with_exact_types(["pos", "vel"])
	print("exact pos,vel: ", exact)
	assert(exact.has(e1))
	assert(not exact.has(e2))

	var sup = world.query(["pos"])
	print("query pos: ", sup)
	assert(sup.has(e1) and sup.has(e2))
	assert(sup[0] < sup[1]) # sorted by index

	# Deduplicate required
	var sup_dedup = world.query(["pos", "pos"])
	assert(sup_dedup == sup)

	# Remove component
	world.remove_component(e1, "vel")
	assert(not world.has_component(e1, "vel"))
	assert(world.get_component_types(e1) == ["pos"])
	assert(world.get_entities_with_exact_types(["pos"]).has(e1))

	# Destroy and reuse
	var gen1 = world.get_generation(e1)
	world.destroy_entity(e1)
	assert(not world.is_alive(e1))
	assert(world.get_component_types(e1) == null)

	# Stale handle behavior
	assert(not world.add_component(e1, "acc", {"x": 0}))
	assert(not world.remove_component(e1, "pos"))
	assert(not world.has_component(e1, "pos"))
	assert(world.get_component(e1, "pos") == null)

	var e3 = world.create_entity()
	print("e3: ", e3)
	assert(world.get_index(e3) == world.get_index(e1))
	assert(world.get_generation(e3) != gen1)
	assert(world.is_alive(e3))
	assert(world.get_component_types(e3).is_empty())
	assert(not world.is_alive(e1))

	print("ALL ASSERTIONS PASSED")
	quit()
